title: MT RBP-BetterMark
description: Subtle Reimagined Indicator for MT Random Block Placement Mod!
body:
Subtle reimagined Indicator for [MT Random Block Placement](https://modrinth.com/mod/random-block-placement)

Less obstrusive, and reimagined to a small green dot by the crosshair.
